parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description:
Instance ID of the WAF instance.

> You can call the [DescribeInstance](~~433756~~) operation to query instance ID of the current WAF instance.

parameters.name: OwnerUserId
parameters.description: The UID of the resource ownership user.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries per page when paging. Default value: **10**.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The region where the WAF instance resides. Valid values:

- **cn-hangzhou**: the Chinese mainland.

- **ap-southeast-1**: outside the Chinese mainland.

parameters.name: ResourceDomain
parameters.description:
The domain name that is added to WAF.
> This parameter is supported only when the cloud service type is ddos.

parameters.name: ResourceInstanceId
parameters.description: The instance ID of the cloud service.

parameters.name: ResourceInstanceIp
parameters.description: The IP address of the instance that is added to WAF.

parameters.name: ResourceInstanceName
parameters.description: The name of the instance that is added to WAF.

parameters.name: ResourceIp
parameters.description: The public IP address of the cloud service.

parameters.name: ResourceManagerResourceGroupId
parameters.description: The Alibaba Cloud resource group ID.

parameters.name: ResourceName
parameters.description: The instance name of the cloud service.

parameters.name: ResourceProduct
parameters.description:
The type of the cloud service. Valid values:

- **clb4**: Layer 4 CLB.

- **clb7**: Layer 7 CLB.

- **ecs**: ECS.
- **nlb**: NLB.
- **ddos**: Anti-DDoS.

parameters.name: ResourceRegionId
parameters.description:
The region ID of the cloud service. Valid values:
- **cn-chengdu**: China Southwest 1 (Chengdu).

- **cn-beijing**: China North 2 (Beijing).

- **cn-zhangjiakou**: China North 3 (Zhangjiakou).

- **cn-hangzhou**: China East 1 (Hangzhou).

- **cn-shanghai**: China East 2 (Shanghai).

- **cn-shenzhen**: China South 1 (Shenzhen).

- **cn-qingdao**: China North 1 (Qingdao).

- **cn-hongkong**: Hong Kong (China).

- **ap-southeast-3**: Malaysia (Kuala Lumpur).

- **ap-southeast-5**: Indonesia (Jakarta).
